## WHAT 4BID DOES
4BID is an Italian company focused on hospitality. It combines revenue-management consulting with proprietary software for hotels and other accommodation businesses.

Primary areas:
- Revenue management and dynamic pricing
- Distribution and OTA strategy
- Direct-booking strategy
- Forecasting, budgeting, ADR and RevPAR analysis
- Hospitality software and AI-assisted decision support
- CRM, operational automation and management-control tools
- Training and custom digital projects for hospitality businesses

## GLOSSARY — KEY TERMS
RevPAR (Revenue Per Available Room): room revenue divided by available rooms; equivalently ADR multiplied by occupancy rate.
ADR (Average Daily Rate): room revenue divided by rooms sold.
Occupancy Rate: rooms sold divided by available rooms.
LOS (Length of Stay): number of nights in a stay.
BAR (Best Available Rate): public reference rate from which other rate plans may derive.
Pick-up: change in booked rooms or revenue over a defined observation period.
Comp Set (Competitive Set): group of comparable competitor properties used for benchmarking.
OTA (Online Travel Agency): online intermediary that distributes accommodation inventory.
Channel Mix: distribution of bookings across direct and intermediary channels.
